content.content:
I'm looking to book a hotel in Paris for May 1st to May 5th.
            Can you suggest a hotel that's under 210? If there are a few choices, go for the one with the highest rating.
            Please give me the hotel's name, rating, price range. Also, can you add an event called "Booking hotel {hotel_name}" to my calendar on April 25th 2024, and set the location to the hotel's address? Just to remind me to book ahead of time. Thanks!

Hotel Names: Le Marais Boutique
Good Night
Luxury Palace
Montmartre Suites

```python
# Get all hotels in Paris
hotels_in_paris = get_all_hotels_in_city("Paris")

# Check if there are hotels
if not hotels_in_paris:
    raise ValueError("No hotels found in Paris.")

# Get prices for all hotels
hotel_prices = get_hotels_prices(hotels_in_paris)

# Get ratings for all hotels
hotel_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_hotels(hotels_in_paris)

# Parse the hotel data to find the best option under 210
# The tools likely return strings, so I need to parse them.
# I will use query_ai_assistant to structure this data and find the best hotel.

hotel_data_query = f"""
Here is a list of hotels in Paris with their prices and ratings.
Prices: {hotel_prices}
Ratings: {hotel_ratings}

Please identify the hotel(s) with a price under 210.
Among those, select the one with the highest rating.
Return the hotel name, its rating, and its price.
"""

class HotelSelection(BaseModel):
    hotel_name: str
    rating: float
    price: float

best_hotel = query_ai_assistant(hotel_data_query, HotelSelection)

# Get the address of the selected hotel
hotel_address = get_hotels_address(best_hotel.hotel_name)

# The address might be a dict or a string. I need to extract the address string.
# Assuming the tool returns a dict like {"address": "..."} or similar.
# I will use query_ai_assistant to extract the address string if it's not already clear.
address_query = f"""
Here is the address information for the hotel {best_hotel.hotel_name}:
{hotel_address}

Extract the full address string.
"""

class AddressInfo(BaseModel):
    address: str

address_info = query_ai_assistant(address_query, AddressInfo)

# Create the calendar event
# Date: April 25th, 2024
# Title: "Booking hotel {hotel_name}"
# Location: Hotel's address
# Time: Not specified, I'll use 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM as a default reminder time.

event_title = f"Booking hotel {best_hotel.hotel_name}"
start_time = "2024-04-25 10:00"
end_time = "2024-04-25 11:00"
description = f"Reminder to book the hotel {best_hotel.hotel_name} for May 1st to May 5th."
location = address_info.address
participants = None # Not specified

create_calendar_event(
    title=event_title,
    start_time=start_time,
    end_time=end_time,
    description=description,
    participants=participants,
    location=location
)

# Print the result
print(f"Selected Hotel: {best_hotel.hotel_name}")
print(f"Rating: {best_hotel.rating}")
print(f"Price: {best_hotel.price}")
print(f"Address: {address_info.address}")
print(f"Calendar event created for April 25th, 2024.")
```
